title: I wasn't trying to say...
content_text:
I wasn't trying to say anything about writing — the ASR just misheard it and I didn't correct it.
Could you rewrite games.html based on that UI SDK note?
Polish the interactions and styling so the page looks cleaner and less AI-generated — kill the purple.
